## Activity

During March 2019, River Outreach completed 67 image captures as part of routine site activity. The recorded activity provides the basis for review of image quality and grading outcomes for the reporting period. Capture activity should continue to be monitored through the usual operational processes, with any recurring equipment or workflow concerns recorded for follow-up.

## Image quality

A total of 5 captures were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 7.5 of all captures recorded during the month. The clinic lead requests that recurring camera issues continue to be logged with the service desk so that they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate support arrangements.

## Grading

Of the results submitted for assessment, 3 were graded as referable. The median grading lag was 0. This indicates that the middle value for grading wait time was 0 for the reporting period. The site should continue to use established processes for submission, review, and escalation of findings, while maintaining records of any issues that may affect image capture or grading.
